title: Observability Config Field Deprecated
summary: The `trackActiveQueryPlan` property within the `ObservabilityInstanceConfig` schema has been marked as deprecated. Developers should update their configurations.
details: The `trackActiveQueryPlan` boolean property, part of the `ObservabilityInstanceConfig` schema, is now officially deprecated. This indicates that the field is no longer recommended for use and may be removed in a future API version. Developers should review their AlloyDB instance configurations and API calls to remove any reliance on this property.
